title: Catalogue renders multiple level-one headings
summary: The product catalogue at /#/search exposes three level-one headings ('Welcome to OWASP Juice Shop!', 'https://owasp-juice.shop', and the page heading) instead of one. Assistive technology cannot determine which heading names the page, so a screen-reader user has no reliable way to identify where they are. Detected by automated accessibility measurement during multi-role discovery, and confirmed by a requirement-traced test that is recorded as a strict expected failure so that fixing the application will surface here rather than silently passing.

evidence.requirement: JS-CAT-2 - The catalogue page shall expose exactly one level-one heading naming the page
evidence.test_status: xfail(strict=True) - tracked open finding, not a silenced failure
evidence.system_under_test: OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0, locally hosted
